ArtifactKind.title: ArtifactKind

AssessmentTable.description: One table per question of interest (M15 Appendix 1, footnote 1).
AssessmentTable.title: AssessmentTable

CPF.description: An immutable, versioned parameter document for one compound.
CPF.title: CPF

CoCompoundSpec.description:
Another compound of a model system in the simulation: dosed with its own protocol (an enantiomer, a co-dosed
parent) or, with no protocol, only formed (a metabolite).
CoCompoundSpec.title: CoCompoundSpec

CompetitiveInhibition.description: Reversible competitive inhibition of an enzyme/transporter (PK-Sim ``CompetitiveInhibition``).
CompetitiveInhibition.title: CompetitiveInhibition

default: Cellular partition coefficient method - Rodgers and Rowland
calculation_methods.title: Calculation Methods

Demographics.description:
The representative individual a study is simulated with (MS-01 §2.3).

Age, sex and population (ethnicity) define a typical PK-Sim individual; PK-Sim derives weight, height
and organ sizes from the population physiology for that age and sex. A study mean ``weight_kg`` /
``height_cm`` is written into the individual's ``OriginData`` (``Weight`` in kg, ``Height`` in cm, keys harvested
from the OSP Midazolam model's Korean individual) and PK-Sim scales the physiology to it.
Demographics.title: Demographics

DosePhase.description:
One phase of a regimen whose doses differ: ``n_doses`` doses of ``dose_mg`` (mg, or mg/kg for a per-kg study),
``interval_h`` apart, the first ``start_h`` after the regimen starts. A loading dose then maintenance is two
phases (OSP Voriconazole, Saari 2006: 400 mg twice 12 h apart, then 200 mg every 12 h from 24 h).
DosePhase.title: DosePhase

DosePhaseSpec.description: One phase of a regimen: ``repetitions`` doses of ``dose``, ``interval_h`` apart, the first at ``start_h``.
DosePhaseSpec.title: DosePhaseSpec

EngineBinding.description:
Where a parameter lives in a PK-Sim snapshot (MS-01 §2.1).

`building_block` is Compound/Individual/Formulation/Protocol. For a compound process the `process`
field carries the process internal name and, for molecule-based processes, the molecule after a
colon, e.g. "MetabolizationSpecific_FirstOrder:CYP3A4"; `parameter` is the engine parameter name.
Individual, Simulation and ExpressionProfile bindings carry the full PK-Sim path in `parameter`. A Simulation
binding's `route` limits it to the simulations dosed that way (the published model sets it only there).
EngineBinding.title: EngineBinding

ExpressionSpec.description:
An enzyme, transporter or other-protein expression profile. Real OSP transporter profiles carry no
Localization (PK-Sim supplies it for the named transporter), so it is emitted only when set; enzymes keep
the standard intracellular localization by default.

``harvested`` is a profile copied verbatim from an OSP reference snapshot (`pbpk_domain.expression`): its
per-organ relative expressions, half-lives, transport directions and ontogeny. Without those every organ's
relative expression is zero and the protein's processes do nothing, so a campaign build always uses a
harvested profile; the bare form (molecule and reference concentration only) exists for builder tests.
ExpressionSpec.title: ExpressionSpec

FeedbackEvidence.description: New evidence after an S5 failure (plan §12.3 N4 c): one parameter's measured value, in the CPF's own unit.
FeedbackEvidence.title: FeedbackEvidence

HarvestedProcess.description:
A process of a type in HARVESTED_PROCESSES, written with exactly the parameters the CPF carries for it (PK-Sim
computes the ones a snapshot leaves out, e.g. kcat from an in-vitro Vmax).
HarvestedProcess.title: HarvestedProcess

IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec.description:
An IV bolus: PK-Sim ``IntravenousBolus`` with a start time and InputDose, no infusion time (harvested from the
OSP Alfentanil, Midazolam, Digoxin, Metformin and Verapamil protocols, simple and schema form).
IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec.title: IntravenousBolusProtocolSpec

MappingBody.description:
How to read a sheet: the page's form (`form`) or a mapping recipe (`proposal`, the data-mapping agent's shape or
written by a person); the study facts the sheet does not state; and whether to keep the result (False: preview).
MappingBody.title: MappingBody

Measured.description: A value with its unit and provenance, as it will appear in the snapshot.
Measured.title: Measured

MichaelisMentenMetabolism.description:
Saturable enzyme metabolism (PK-Sim ``MetabolizationSpecific_MM``). Parameter names and units are
from the OSP Rifampicin model; Vmax and Km are the identifiable pair (MS-01 §2.2), kcat and enzyme
concentration are optional and only emitted when supplied.
MichaelisMentenMetabolism.title: MichaelisMentenMetabolism

MicrosomalMichaelisMenten.description:
Saturable metabolism scaled from liver microsomes (PK-Sim ``MetabolizationLiverMicrosomes_MM``). Names and
units are from the OSP Midazolam model (CYP3A4, UGT1A4): the in-vitro Vmax per mg microsomal protein and, where
the model sets it, the enzyme content of the microsomes; Km; and kcat, which the published model fits and which
then governs the in-vivo rate.
MicrosomalMichaelisMenten.title: MicrosomalMichaelisMenten

ParticleFormulationSpec.description:
Particle dissolution (PK-Sim ``Formulation_Particles``, Noyes-Whitney) with a monodisperse size distribution,
as the OSP Ketoconazole model writes it: the unstirred water layer thickness, the distribution type (0:
monodisperse, the only one placed here) and the mean particle radius. Dissolution is limited by the compound's
solubility, so a "solution" given as 8 nm particles (the model's PD_solution) still respects it.
ParticleFormulationSpec.title: ParticleFormulationSpec

objective.default: Predict exposure for the question of interest
objective.title: Objective

PublishedIndividual.description:
The individual a published model simulates one study in, when it differs from the model's main individual
(the OSP Rifampicin model's "EHC off" individual for its 7-day study; the Midazolam model's Korean individual,
CYP3A5 *3/*3, for Yu 2004). ``parameters`` is that individual's complete set of physiology overrides (it replaces
the CPF's indiv.* records for this study: a value the main individual sets and this one does not is left at the
PK-Sim default, never invented); ``expression`` holds its profile values that differ from the harvested library.
Paths and units are copied from the snapshot.
PublishedIndividual.title: PublishedIndividual

QuestionOfInterest.description: The parts of the question the split depends on (MS-01 §3.3 rules 4 and 5).
QuestionOfInterest.title: QuestionOfInterest

SheetForm.description: What a person tells the page about one sheet. Columns are letters; rows are the sheet's own row numbers.

header_row.description: The row with the column headers (times across: the times)
header_row.title: Header Row

SheetForm.title: SheetForm

SpecificBinding.description: Specific binding to a target (PK-Sim ``SpecificBinding``); names/units from the OSP Midazolam model.
SpecificBinding.title: SpecificBinding

StudyRecord.description: A clinical study as it arrives from intake (MS-01 §3.1), reduced to the fields the split needs.
StudyRecord.title: StudyRecord

TransporterMichaelisMenten.description:
Saturable active transport (PK-Sim ``ActiveTransportSpecific_MM``). Names/units from the OSP
Rifampicin model. The transporter needs an expression profile (``ExpressionSpec`` type Transporter).
TransporterMichaelisMenten.title: TransporterMichaelisMenten

Uncertainty.description: A fitted parameter's precision, from the parameter identification's confidence-interval estimate.
Uncertainty.title: Uncertainty
